name: The Children's Aid Society, Mumbai.
description: In the year 1921, the Government of Bombay expressed in the Legislative Council, its resolve to bring in a Children's Act. Three years later {1924} the Bombay Children's Act was passed. Eventually, in November, 1926, Sir Earnest Hotson, the then Home Member, Government of Bombay convened a conference of Social Workers, which led to the formation of the Children's Aid Society on March 1927. His Excellency Sir Leslie Wilson was the President and the Hon'ble Mr. E. B. Hotson C. S. I., I. C. S. was the Chairman and the Committee consisted of eminent persons of the time.

featured_reviews.name: Eknath Chandrakant Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
ABOUT PRAJA

Praja is a non-partisan organisation working towards enabling accountable governance since 1999. Praja empowers citizens to participate in governance by providing knowledge and perspective so that they can become politically active and involved beyond the ballot box. It undertakes extensive research and highlights civic issues to build the awareness of, and mobilize action by the government and elected representatives (ERs).

THE PROBLEM

Praja believes that uninformed and disengaged ERs and administration, rather than existing systems or policies, are responsible for the lack of good governance. There is a paucity of tools to facilitate effective interaction between citizens and the local government.

PRAJA's RESPONSE

Praja conducts data driven research and provides information on civic issues to citizens, media, and government administration and works with ERs to identify and address inefficiencies in their work processes, bridge the information gaps, and help them in taking corrective measures.

HOW DID IT EVOLVE?

1999: Praja, along with the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC), created Mumbai's first Citizen Charter
2003: Teamed up with BMC and built its citizens' grievance redressal mechanism, the Online Complaint and Management System (OCMS), and conducted complaint audits in the ensuing years
2005: Published Mumbai Citizen's Handbook to demystify governance in Mumbai; About 2 lakh copies distributed
2008: Initiated Praja Dialogue; launched CityScan, an online collation of extensive data on civic and security Issues In Mumbai; Published councillor handbook; and annual report cards on MLAs, and councillors
2014: Conducted workshops with ERs, educating them on policies and roles; started the Delhi Chapter to replicate the model developed In Mumbai
2016: Launched MLA and Councillor Report Cards in Delhi

featured_reviews.name: Khan Ahmed
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently reached out to Awaan Charitable Trust for educational support, and honestly, I did not expect such a quick and smooth response. Within a very short time, they helped me without asking for complicated paperwork or making the process stressful.
In today’s time, it is rare to find organizations that genuinely understand a student’s situation and act so fast. Their team was polite, respectful, and truly concerned about helping rather than just following formalities.
I am deeply grateful for their support. May they continue helping many more students like me who are trying to build their future despite financial difficulties.
Highly recommended for anyone seeking genuine and timely assistance.

featured_reviews.name: ARU
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an incredible experience with Tribes For Good! The program was well-organized, deeply impactful, and gave me a real chance to contribute to meaningful social change. The team is passionate, supportive, and truly dedicated to mentoring the next generation of changemakers. Highly recommend this program to anyone looking to make a genuine difference!

featured_reviews.name: Akshara Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Working with TribesForGood was an enriching expereince! My mentors were really supportive and I definitely learnt a lot. I look forward to using these skills to drive positive change in my community, contribute to the betterment of society, and continue developing as an effective changemaker.

featured_reviews.name: Jiya Broker
featured_reviews.review_text: It was a wonderful experience with The Tribes  of Good . It helped me transform my ideas and shape it into a beautiful community project.

featured_reviews.name: Anaya Taneja
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an amazing experience working with TribesForGood. As a part of my program, I worked with various NGO's and helped uplift small businesses. The mentors were always supportive and were always available to provide guidance.  The program helped me improve my communication skills aiding me to connect with and help others, and create a social impact. It truly was an enriching experience.

featured_reviews.name: Riddhi Kathe
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an amazing experience with TribesForGood. They provided excellent support and guidance throughout my volunteering journey. The mentors were always available to help and answer my questions. I felt welcomed and grew personally and professionally. I made great friends with other volunteers. The programs were well-structured and made a positive impact in the community. I gained valuable skills and experiences. Thank you for the incredible volunteering journey!

featured_reviews.name: Jahnavi Baweja
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience with TribesForGood was enriching and I learnt many new things and experiences. Whether you are passionate about educating people, social justice for example gender inequality or even the climate, then TribesForGood provides a big platform where you can showcase your passion along with other like-minded people who are set out to achieve the same goal. Most importantly I acquired new skills and made a positive social impact. Personally, I enjoyed the fieldwork sessions where I could teach underprivileged youngsters about the importance of physical and mental health. I thing TribesForGood provided me with an amazing opportunity to give back to the society and my experience with them was incredible.

featured_reviews.name: Amogh Raghavendra
featured_reviews.review_text: TribesForGood is a wonderful organization that helps you make an impactful change to the world. TribesForGood sparks the inner leader in you, and helps you take initiative for a variety of projects, such as: online field work sessions, where you act as a mentor and teach children topics that suite your interests, and community projects, where you interact with a local institution to make a change. TribesForGood taught me important leadership skills during my field work sessions, and I had to apply those skills in the community projects. It was truly an amazing experience!

featured_reviews.name: Sanah Sehgal
featured_reviews.review_text: Whether you are passionate about education, the environment, or social justice, TribesForGood provides a platform for you to connect with like-minded individuals and create a positive impact together. By joining TribesForGood, I got the opportunity to gain valuable skills and experiences. It provided me with skills like leadership and project management, as well as the chance to collaborate with professionals during my fieldwork sessions and my community projects. This experience not only empowered me as a leader but also left a lasting impact on the communities we worked with.
